content:
We have a new release candidate of Lean, v4.34.0-rc2. See the release notes for more information.

This release candidate contains the same runtime and kernel fixes as v4.33.1, including three soundness fixes; we encourage all users on v4.34.0-rc1 to upgrade.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.34.0-rc2 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.110). We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.34.0-rc2 when possible, and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating.
